jobs.title: 2nd level Engineer Backoffice IT Operation
jobs.description:
Shift4 (NYSE: FOUR) is boldly redefining commerce by simplifying complex payments ecosystems across the world. As the leader in commerce-enabling technology, Shift4 powers billions of transactions annually for hundreds of thousands of businesses in virtually every industry. For more information, visit www.shift4.com.

What You Will Do. A Glimpse In Your Role

As an Application Support Engineer, you will play a critical role in ensuring the reliability, stability, and smooth operation of our in‑house DBO applications, built on modern .NET, Angular, and MSSQL architectures. You will work close to production systems, supporting distributed, event‑driven platforms and continuously improving operational excellence.

You will collaborate closely with Developers, QA, DevOps, UX, and Product teams to investigate issues, optimize operability, and drive continuous service improvements. This role requires strong analytical thinking, clear communication, operational awareness, and a passion for automation and developer experience.

Every action has an impact. You will make a difference here if you:

Provide L2 application support, ensuring high availability, resilience, and operational continuity of production systems.
Troubleshoot complex production issues using logs, dashboards, metrics, and traces, applying deep system knowledge to resolve incidents efficiently.
Support Kubernetes-based workloads, including pod diagnostics, log analysis, restarts, probes, networking, and scaling behavior.
Investigate backend and API issues, event‑driven flows using RabbitMQ, and database‑related problems in MSSQL.
Collaborate in incident response, post‑incident reviews, root‑cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Maintain and continuously improve runbooks, SOPs, and internal knowledge bases.
Participate in release validation and operational readiness reviews to ensure production stability.
Create, understand, and maintain basic automation scripts using PowerShell and Bash to reduce manual operations.
Contribute to DevOps and Developer Experience (DevEx) improvements, including CI/CD reliability, deployment consistency, and environment stability.
Enhance observability and service telemetry through actionable alerts, dashboards, and monitoring improvements.
Apply secure‑by‑design principles, following OWASP guidelines, OIDC/OAuth2 standards, and compliance requirements.
Leverage AI‑assisted tools for scripting, log analysis, diagnostics, and documentation—while critically validating outputs.
Participate in on‑call rotations, out‑of‑hours deployments, and incident support when required.

Key competencies to empower your journey. You'll drive towards success if:

You have strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with a structured approach to incident investigation.
You are comfortable working in production environments and understand the operational impact of your actions.
You communicate clearly and effectively, adapting technical topics for different audiences.
You work well independently and thrive as part of a cross‑functional, multicultural team.
You are proactive, curious, and motivated by continuous improvement.
You enjoy working in regulated and high‑availability environments.

Skills

Scripting and automation using PowerShell and Bash.
Strong understanding of .NET‑based services, including API behavior, configuration, logging, diagnostics, and C# fundamentals.
Hands‑on experience with REST APIs and tools such as Postman.
Solid SQL skills (preferably MSSQL): query writing, debugging, and data validation.
Experience with RabbitMQ, including message flows, retries, DLQs, and event‑driven troubleshooting.
Log analysis and monitoring using Splunk, including writing queries and building dashboards.
Kubernetes fundamentals: pods, events, probes, restarts, configs, and scaling.
Observability concepts: logs, metrics, traces, and dashboard‑driven analysis.
CI/CD fundamentals, including troubleshooting pipelines and quality gates.
Experience with deployment tools such as Jenkins.
Security awareness, including OWASP basics, OIDC/OAuth2 flows, and secure secret handling.
AI‑assisted operational work: log insights, script drafting, and documentation support.
Strong administrative experience with ticketing systems such as Jira, ServiceNow, Xurrent, or similar.
Frontend debugging experience using browser developer tools and a basic understanding of JavaScript.
Experience in financial services or PCI‑DSS regulated environments is a strong plus.
Solid experience with Microsoft Office tools, Active Directory, and Windows Server.

Qualifications And Education Requirements

University degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of experience in application support or production operations.
Hands‑on experience supporting distributed systems in modern Agile environments.
Exposure to ITIL or service management practices (ITIL Foundation preferred).
Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal.

Together, We Go Further

At Global Blue, great work happens when talented people come together in a supportive and inspiring environment. Here’s what you can expect:

A role in a fast‑growing, international company
Opportunities for professional development and career growth
A multicultural workplace, collaborating with colleagues across regions
An inspiring team and a dynamic, forward‑thinking culture
A range of employee benefits, including: Employee referral program; Team‑building activities and events; Annual Christmas Party and more

We foster career growth through internal mobility, embrace an Agile Working Model, and prioritize work‑life balance. Committed to sustainability, we focus on creating positive impacts for employees, clients, and communities. Guided by our 5 Ways of Working, we value collaboration, innovation, client satisfaction, and shared success.

Feels like you? Explore further!

Let’s write the future together: apply now!

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Developer with Automation Testing experience
jobs.description:
Founded in 1999 in Vienna, the Qualysoft Group is a manufacturer-independent IT consulting and services company, which successfully provides support for its international customers with the aim of boosting their competitiveness and economic efficiency through innovative IT solutions.

Its focus is on financial services providers, telecommunications companies, the automotive industry and energy service providers. Over 400 employees in 6 subsidiaries work together to ensure state of the art solutions for our clients.

We are looking for new colleagues in Qualysoft teams for diverse projects providing continuous learning opportunities. Our common goal is to provide honesty, development and a stable background while getting to know the latest technologies. We are waiting for your application for the position below!

Location:
Remote, with 1 day per week onsite in Budapest preferred

Project duration:
Immediate start – 31 December 2027

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Developer with Test Automation experience
to join an established delivery team working on financing solutions for private customers, including consumer loans and revolving credit facilities. The successful candidate will contribute to the development of modern web applications, workflow-driven business processes, and distributed backend services, with the expectation of becoming productive quickly after onboarding.

Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain modern Angular single-page applications (SPA).
Develop and integrate RESTful APIs and backend services within a distributed system landscape.
Design and implement new features independently, from technical concept through delivery.
Work with Camunda (or a comparable workflow/process automation platform) to implement and optimize business processes.
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams in an agile environment (Scrum/LeSS).
Participate in end-to-end solution development across multiple systems and interfaces.
Contribute to test automation and ensure high software quality standards.
Support CI/CD practices and deployment processes.
Quickly understand complex business processes and translate business requirements into technical solutions.
Actively contribute to the team's delivery goals and continuous improvement initiatives.

Requirements

Several years of professional experience developing applications with modern Angular.
Strong hands-on experience integrating REST APIs.
Experience working in complex distributed system environments with multiple interfaces and end-to-end business processes.
Experience with Camunda or a comparable workflow/process automation platform.
Full-stack development experience with Java and Microservices.
Ability to independently design, implement, and deliver software features.
Senior-level software engineering experience (junior profiles will not be considered).
Experience with test automation.
Experience working in Agile environments (Scrum and/or LeSS).
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Self-driven, proactive, and delivery-oriented mindset.
Excellent English communication skills; German is considered an advantage.

Advantages

Experience with CI/CD tools and practices, including Git, Jenkins, and OpenShift.
Previous experience in the banking or financial services industry.
Experience working in geographically distributed teams.

Why We Think You Will Love Working Here

With us you count as a person, our doors are always open.

We live the Qualysoft Team Spirit and stand for transparency!

Fresh wind and new ideas are welcome, because standstill is a foreign word at Qualysoft.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer (Remote Eligible in Bulgaria)
jobs.description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

We are looking for a skilled and motivated Principal Software Engineer who is passionate about continuous learning and eager to grow along with us in a fast-paced, innovative environment.

You will work remotely from Bulgaria and will be reporting to an engineering leader located in Bulgaria.

You Will

Lead the design and implementation of Smartsheet's next-generation architecture, ensuring scalability, security, and performance for millions of global users.
Define and drive architecture strategy, making key technical decisions that shape the future of the platform.
Review and guide technical project designs, providing feedback during design review presentations to ensure system resilience and scalability.
Take ownership of cross-functional technical initiatives, aligning teams around common architectural goals while driving large-scale projects to completion.
Foster strong technical leadership, mentoring senior engineers and influencing best practices across multiple engineering teams.
Lead deployment reviews for high-impact projects, ensuring they meet scalability, performance, and security requirements.
Collaborate closely with product management and other business stakeholders to balance market needs with technical constraints, driving innovation while maintaining technical rigor.
Advocate for quality and operational excellence, ensuring systems are monitored, tested, and maintained to meet the highest reliability standards.
Perform other duties as assigned.

You Have

Proven experience in system architecture and the design of scalable, high-availability systems across multiple programming languages and frameworks (Python, Go, Java, C/C++, SQL).
Deep understanding of distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and microservices.
Strong experience in leading large-scale architectural transformations, with the ability to influence technical direction across multiple teams.
Expertise in web application development, data structures, and object-oriented design.
A track record of mentoring senior engineers, leading them through architectural challenges, and ensuring they grow into strong technical leaders.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior executives.
Experience with cloud architectures and infrastructure at scale, as well as database optimization for performance and scalability.
Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, driving initiatives forward while aligning with business objectives.
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies, driving engineering best practices across teams.
Legally eligible to work in Bulgaria on an ongoing basis.
Fluency in English is required.

Smartsheet provides a competitive base salary range for roles that may be hired in different geographic areas we are licensed to operate our business from. In addition, this role will be eligible for a market competitive incentive opportunity.

We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.

jobs.title: Cloud Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Purpose

As a Cloud Platform Engineer, you are part of the team responsible for delivering the internal cloud platform that enables our SaaS product teams to build, deploy, and operate reliably in Azure and AWS. This role focuses on building platform capabilities that are reusable, secure, observable, and easy to consume. You will engage in full lifecycle delivery from implementation and automation to hardening, supportability, and continuous improvement.

You’ll be working in an enablement team that treats platform components as versioned products, with stable interfaces, high documentation standards, and a relentless focus on reducing cognitive load and operational friction for R&D, Cloud Security, SRE and Cloud Operations teams. You will collaborate with these users to ensure consistent and efficient use of the platform.

Key Responsibilities

Deliver modular, secure, and reusable infrastructure components using Terraform, backed by automation pipelines and telemetry.
Implement platform capabilities such as Kubernetes clusters, ingress, networking, observability, data services, and identity integrations as standardized building blocks.
Embed operational resilience logging, metrics, alerting as default characteristics of the platform.
Integrate cloud security and compliance requirements (e.g., IAM boundaries, encryption, audit readiness) into the delivery pipeline in collaboration with the Cloud Security Operations team.
Develop internal APIs, CLI tools, or service wrappers that simplify infrastructure consumption and improve developer experience.
Maintain and evolve platform components through versioning, lifecycle policies, and continuous refactoring based on telemetry and platform feedback.
Providing documentation, usage examples, and onboarding guides is essential to facilitate the adoption of a platform and reduce the support burden. The ability to share knowledge and create comprehensive documentation are fundamental skills for a cloud platform engineer.
Participate in planning, refinement, and technical review sessions to align with platform architecture and cross-functional delivery priorities.
Act as a mentor and enabler for the Cloud Operations team members
Utilize AI-enabled tools (e.g., chatbots, documentation automation, analytics assistants) to improve efficiency, accuracy, and streamline routine tasks while following company AI governance and data privacy standards

Base salary range: For this role, based in Bulgaria, the base salary range is €25000-65000 per year, set using objective, gender-neutral job evaluation criteria applied to all employees performing this role or work of equal value.

Determining your actual pay: Your base salary within this range will be based on objective, gender-neutral factors — work location, skills, qualifications, experience, and education/training. It will not be reduced based on prior salary or negotiating position, nor will it fall below the range or below what colleagues in equal work receive.

Scope: This range covers base salary only, not bonuses, benefits, or other remuneration (as applicable).

Your rights: Tungsten Automation does not ask about current or past pay, and you need not disclose it. This notice does not limit your right to negotiate or your entitlement to equal pay for equal work or work of equal value.

While the job description describes what is anticipated as the requirements of the position, the job requirements are subject to change based upon any changing needs and requirements of the business.

Required Skills

Required Qualifications

Solid hands-on experience in infrastructure delivery or platform engineering roles in a cloud-native environment
Proficient with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices, working knowledge of CI/CD (e.g., GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps)
Experience developing tooling or platform components using a higher-level programming language such as Java, C#, or C++
Strong understanding of cloud services in Azure and/or AWS
Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration; familiarity with cluster provisioning and workload identity
Knowledge of securing infrastructure components and implementing policy-as-code.
Scripting and automation experience (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Bash)
Familiarity with observability concepts (logs, metrics, traces) and how to make them first-class in infrastructure
Strong collaboration and documentation skills; able to deliver structured solutions with a product mindset
Skills in prompting AI systems and assessing output quality
Ability to leverage AI to ideate, develop and scale to the needs of the department

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building internal platforms, golden paths, or self-service developer experiences.
Familiarity with GitOps workflows
Exposure to policy-as-code frameworks and configuration hardening standards (e.g., CIS benchmarks).
Experience working in regulated environments (SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP) and integrating compliance into infrastructure delivery.
Understanding of platform SLOs, Error budgets, operational maturity models, and infrastructure lifecycle thinking.

As a successful Cloud Platform Engineer

You think in abstractions, not just scripts. You build for reusability, stability, and clarity knowing that your users are other engineers relying on your work to move faster and safer. You’re driven by delivery, not novelty, and thrive on solving operational complexity through design, automation, and simplification. You treat infrastructure the same way great product teams treat software as something to be designed, tested, versioned, and continuously improved.

jobs.title: Senior Adviser - Business Solutions Engineer (Investment Services) (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Find your purpose at KPMG Luxembourg

Join a team of diverse and dedicated problem solvers, connected by a common cause: to turn insight into opportunity for clients and communities around the world. If you are eager to learn, are interested in growing rapidly and strive to make an impact in a diverse environment, you're in the right place at the right time.

Learn more about Careers at KPMG Luxembourg

Job Description

We are looking for a Business Solutions Engineer for our Investment Services field

Our Investment Services team is developing an internal platform that supports the management of cross-border fund registrations and regulatory operations. The platform is developed directly with the business teams who use it daily.

We are looking for a business solutions engineer who enjoys working within a business team, understanding operational needs and translating them into practical digital solutions. This is not a traditional IT delivery role: you will work closely with fund regulatory specialists and contribute to both product decisions and technical implementation.

What You Will Be Working On

Continue the design and development of the platform.
Work directly with business users to understand processes, identify pain points and define appropriate solutions.
Translate regulatory and operational requirements into maintainable product features.
Develop workflows for fund registrations, regulatory filings, publications, billing and client reporting.
Build and improve front end interfaces for operational teams.
Develop backend services, APIs and business logic using C# and .NET.
Design data models and queries.
Develop document generation, classification and processing capabilities.
Contribute to AI-assisted features using Microsoft Foundry and Azure AI services.
Write automated tests and participate in testing with business users.
Support the transition of new features into daily operational use.

What We Look For

At least 3 to 5 years of professional software development experience, preferably on business-critical web applications.
Proven experience developing full-stack solutions with C#, .NET, ASP.NET and SQL.
Demonstrated experience working directly with business users and translating operational requirements into technical solutions.
Experience maintaining and extending an existing application, including understanding unfamiliar code and improving it incrementally.
Practical experience with data modelling, system integrations, APIs and structured-data processing.
Experience using AI-assisted coding tools, such as GitHub Copilot.
Experience applying software engineering practices such as source control, code reviews and automated testing.
Experience with Azure or AI services is an advantage.
Experience in investment funds, financial services, regulatory reporting or workflow automation is beneficial but not mandatory.
Familiarity with Apache Spark is an advantage.

What You Will Get

We offer more than just a job. With our flexible work model, you can work, rest and recharge. Our competitive compensation packages, paid time off, recognition bonuses and dedicated programs for personal development and well-being help to keep you refreshed and motivated.

We will accompany you on a journey of professional growth, offering an expansive spectrum of prospects to elevate your career in Luxembourg, an emerging financial center. Feel a sense of belonging by enjoying year-round celebrations and engaging events that bring us all together.

Join our next generation
